_about: Data of the night_street set (the v3 clock-shop street). Read by tools/build_props.py (marks, front) and by src/episode/sets.tsx. Marks = feet positions on the ground (meters).

mark_notes.lantern_spot: where Bram stands in v3: his raised pole touches the lantern seen from the v3 hook camera
mark_notes.across_window: not a feet mark: the window across the street that lights up (camera aim point)
mark_notes.street_far: middle of the street, far side: film it with camera front [0, 0, -1] for a cool shot (facades + sky behind, no shop window)

lights.lantern: hanging lantern by the shop door (0 = off, 1 = on); flickers
lights.window_across: the window across the street (0 = dark, 1 = lit), warms characters near it

_camera_bounds: box the camera must stay inside (walls, facades); presets shorten their distance to fit
